chunks.text: Docker containers package applications with their dependencies into portable images built from Dockerfiles.
Docker Compose orchestrates multi-container local stacks with services, networks, and named volumes.
Container registries store tagged images so teams can pull the same build into every environment.
PostgreSQL stores relational tables and answers SQL queries with ACID transactions.
B-tree indexes speed up selective lookups on primary keys and foreign key joins.
VACUUM and ANALYZE keep table statistics fresh so the planner chooses efficient plans.
Kubernetes schedules pods onto cluster nodes and restarts them when health checks fail.
Deployments manage replica sets so rolling updates replace pods without downtime.
Services expose a stable ClusterIP so clients reach pods even as replicas change.
